why_the_bound_did_not_help: The residual actor (lr 3e-4, 100x the direct arm) climbs the same action-insensitive critic (2 heads, 1-step) within its bound and reaches the bound quickly in the critic's preferred, wrong direction. R_MAX 0.15 per coefficient (~7% of the action range) is more than enough to break a contact-rich grasp: 2.66 deg of executed error at the first post-warmup checkpoint. A bound limits the SIZE of the damage, not its direction; only the critic determines direction. This is consistent with g1_piston_critic_exploitation.json and makes run 8 (critic repair) the decisive test.
